question: Choose the antonym of 'assert":
solution:
The correct answer is: **Deny**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"assert"** means to state a fact or belief confidently and forcefully. (दृढ़तापूर्वक कहना)

 
 
• **Example:** She asserted her innocence during the investigation.
 
 
 
• **"Deny"** refers to the act of refusing to accept or admit something. It is the opposite of asserting. (अस्वीकार करना)
 
 
• **Example:** He denied stealing the money despite the evidence against him.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **'assert'** is **'deny'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Deny**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Maintain** (बनाए रखना): To keep something in its existing state or to continue to affirm something.

 
 
• **Example:** She maintained her claim despite the objections.
 
 
 
• **Proclaim** (घोषणा करना): To announce something publicly or officially.
 
 
• **Example:** The president proclaimed a new policy for economic growth.
 
 
 
• **Declare** (घोषित करना): To make something known formally or officially.
 
 
• **Example:** He declared his intention to run for office.
